answer: To resist sybils, each agent must tend one unique identity orchard whose plot id is bound to a single staking key and a delayed-unbonding bond. Peers only increment harvest weight when independent graders confirm the same plot across epochs; a recycled wallet cannot quickly forge a second plot because the bond's cooldown and the plot hash are non-transferable. Settlement weight accrues only after the bond's patina turns umber—an aged, slashable record that decays if the stake is split—so cheap clones never reach voting power.
